articles.headline: EU chip security rules begin requiring vulnerability and incident notifications
articles.summary: The EU’s Cyber Resilience Act starts requiring manufacturers to notify actively exploited vulnerabilities and serious incidents affecting digital products. Businesses buying hardware and software in Europe should expect tighter compliance obligations, more security disclosures, and higher vendor scrutiny.

articles.headline: Broadcom lifts AI semiconductor revenue outlook sharply
articles.summary: Broadcom’s huge AI chip revenue and higher forecast signal sustained demand for AI infrastructure across data centers and enterprise workloads. That can affect supplier planning, chip availability, and the cost structure of AI deployments for large and mid-sized businesses.

articles.headline: TCS unit to invest up to $7.4 billion in AI data center campus
articles.summary: India’s TCS is planning a major AI data center campus investment, signaling more demand for compute, power, and infrastructure services. For businesses, this points to rising AI infrastructure spending and potentially stronger competition for capacity, which can affect cloud costs and deployment plans.
